findings.option_text: They fall as the warning in the gas gets weaker, so eleven is a good figure.
findings.killing_span: Crowdleigh’s sheet reads like a slope: three at the cottage nearest the vessel, five at the farm office halfway up, eleven at the bungalow.

findings.category: refuted by a span asserting something incompatible with it
findings.note: Direction is inverted twice over: the figures RISE with distance from the vessel (3→5→11) exactly as the odorant is stripped, and the working threshold is four, so eleven is the worst reading on the sheet, not a good one.

findings.option_text: He counts the quarter-turns of the valve before the smell gets through to him.

findings.corroborating_span: The box is honest about the dilution and silent about the nose
findings.category: refuted by a span asserting something incompatible with it
findings.note: The same sentence that licenses C states what the recorded figure is (a dilution in parts per thousand); the quarter-turns are the method of approach, never the quantity written down.

findings.option_text: He works them out from the length of pipe between each house and the supply.
findings.killing_span: The box counts in parts of gas to a thousand parts of air: the figure he writes down is the fraction he needs in front of him before he can smell anything.
findings.corroborating_span: The box is honest about the dilution and silent about the nose
findings.category: refuted by a span asserting something incompatible with it
findings.note: The figure is measured at the sink, not derived from run length; the slope is the OUTPUT of those measurements, not their input.

justification: Key C supported by: “the figure he writes down is the fraction he needs in front of him before he can smell anything” — Stem asks what we are told about the numbers he writes down. The key is carried by a colon-definition sentence naming the recorded quantity outright. Re-derived against the current stem: B and D both die on that same definition sentence (it fixes what the number IS, which is what the stem now asks), and A dies on the slope sentence plus the stated threshold of four. No option is merely unmentioned.

findings.option_text: It is added at the estate rather than at the depot, once the joints are proved.

findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: The span names the depot as the dosing point, negating “at the estate rather than at the depot” word for word.

findings.option_text: It clings to the wall once the steel has begun to corrode in service.
findings.killing_span: it carries mill scale from the rolling and a bloom of rust from the weeks the lengths stood in the yard
findings.corroborating_span: Bare oxide takes the most, so a main scrubs hardest in the week it goes into service; a wide bore takes more than a narrow one; and slow gas gives up more than fast gas, which on a new estate makes it worse. Age works the other way about.
findings.category: refuted by a span asserting something incompatible with it
findings.note: WEAKEST DISTRACTOR IN THE BATCH. Its main clause (the mercaptan sticks to the wall) is true of the text; only the temporal clause kills it — the oxide arrived in the YARD before service, uptake is maximal in the first week of service, age works the other way about, and the decades-old farm line takes nothing. RECOMMENDATION: if this unit is ever re-cut, narrow the option to the adsorption claim alone so it dies on a cleaner span (e.g. “It only begins to cling once the main has been in service some years”), or leave as is — the refutation holds, but on one clause rather than the whole option.

findings.option_text: It reaches the house more or less intact and is lost at the cooker instead.
findings.killing_span: Either way the gas that leaves the far end has less smell in it than the gas that went in, and the further it has travelled against that wall, the less it has.
findings.category: refuted by a span asserting something incompatible with it
findings.note: The loss is located in the run, before the house; “more or less intact” is contradicted by the measured slope 3→5→11.

justification: Key A supported by: “Some is oxidised on contact into a disulphide, a serviceable molecule that is no use as a warning, because it hardly smells.” — Key is stated outright (oxidation to a hardly-smelling disulphide) and is the only option describing what BECOMES of the compound. B and D die on explicit contrary assertions. C is refuted but on its timing clause only; recorded as the batch's weakest kill, with a recommendation in this finding. No merely-unmentioned option.

findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: Explicit: longer, not shorter.

findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: Explicit: same bore, so bore cannot be the discriminator.

findings.note: Explicit: same vessel, same fill.

Strongest single refutation engine in the batch. All three non-keys explicitly negated.

findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: Both halves explicitly negated: three or four times the ordinary dose, and no date fixable in advance.

A, C, D each die on an explicit contrary statement. No merely-unmentioned option.

The three non-keys are three different mis-readings of the same sentence and each dies on it (plus, for C, the twenty-six-houses sentence). No merely-unmentioned option.

Thinnest key support in the batch (discourse-level, as cloze keys always are) but not thinner than any distractor's kill.

findings.category: refuted by a span asserting something incompatible with it
findings.note: Både fästet (häftstift, inte glas) och platsen (utanför tvättstugan, inte entrén) är angående annorlunda.

findings.option_text: Den ägnar förslaget en halv sida.
findings.killing_span: Punkten är en rad lång
findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: Ordagrann negering: en rad, inte en halv sida.

findings.option_text: Den säger var förslagets stolpar ska stå.
findings.killing_span: Var de ska stå framgår inte.
findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: Ordagrann negering.

justification: Key C supported by: “styrelsens förslag står där som punkt sju” — Nyckeln står i samma mening som platsen för kallelsen. Alla tre distraktorer fälls på spänn inom samma stycke, två av dem ordagrant. Ingen är enbart onämnd.

findings.option_text: Det restes för att hålla obehöriga ute.
findings.killing_span: Ett räcke i knähöjd är inte byggt för att hålla någon ute
findings.corroborating_span: man kliver över det i ett steg
findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: WORLD-PRIOR (ett räcke stänger ute). Ordagrant negerad, med skälet utsatt.

findings.option_text: Det var så utsatt att det byttes ofta.
findings.killing_span: Räcket är det ursprungliga.
findings.corroborating_span: Under den översta slanan står ett namn och ett årtal skurna i virket: Börje Ängman, 1934.
findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: Ordagrann negering plus det inskurna årtalet 1934.

findings.option_text: Det är omålat på båda sidor.
findings.killing_span: Insidan har sin gamla gröna färg i behåll.
findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: Insidan är målad; ytterssidans blankslitning är nötning, inte avsaknad av färg.

justification: Key D supported by: “det skymmer inte sikten. Från gräset utanför ser man golvet från kant till kant.” — Nyckeln står i klartext i samma mening som knähöjden. Alla tre distraktorer explicit negerade på var sitt spänn. Ingen är enbart onämnd.

findings.option_text: Den kom av att taket vilade på en stolpe mitt på golvet.
findings.killing_span: Banan ligger under bar himmel, utan tak och utan stolpar inne på golvet.
findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: WORLD-PRIOR (rund bana = mittstolpe/tak). Ordagrant negerad: varken tak eller stolpar inne på golvet.

findings.option_text: Den lät paren höra spelmännen lika bra på hela golvet.
findings.killing_span: Spelmännen satt på en låg scen vid ena kanten, utanför räcket, och längst bort på banan hördes de sämre.
findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: WORLD-PRIOR (rundning för akustikens skull). Musiken kom från kanten och hördes sämre längst bort — formen jämnade inte ut ljudet.

findings.option_text: Den förde regnvattnet ut mot kanterna, så att det rann av utanför golvets brädor.
findings.killing_span: Golvet ligger plant på sina syllar, och regnet rinner ner mellan brädorna.
findings.category: refuted by a span that explicitly negates it
findings.note: WORLD-PRIOR (völvt golv för avrinning). Golvet är plant och vattnet rinner ned mellan brädorna, inte ut mot kanten.

justification: Key A supported by: “Rundningen var inte det billiga valet: den kostade virke, för brädorna i kanten fick sågas krokiga och spillet blev stort.” — Båda leden i nyckeln står i klartext: enkelriktad trafik i ett band längs kanten (“paren går åt samma håll, motsols”, hörnen som stoppunkter fyra gånger per varv) och rundningen som det dyrare valet. Tre kanoniska förklaringar till rund form — mittstolpe, akustik, avrinning — ligger i distraktorerna och fälls var och en ordagrant. Ingen är enbart onämnd.
